messages:
noah: Hey team — need to provision an EU GPU node pool in europe-north1 for low-latency model serving. Use-case: realtime chat + embeddings for EU customers. Suggested plan: two pools (realtime and batch/embeds). Realtime: 6 x H100 (non-preemptible). Batch/embeds: 12 x A10G (mix 20% preemptible). AZ-aware spread, autoscaler per-pool min=0 / max=30. Can ops/startup confirm quotas and any NAT/egress constraints before I open the formal request?

maria: Quick Qs — what's expected steady GPU pod count and per-pod GPU request? Do we need local SSDs? I still prefer separate pools per SKU (avoid mixing H100/A10G in one pool). H100 should be non-preemptible; A10G ok preemptible. Suggest taints: `gpu=h100:NoSchedule` and `gpu=a10g:NoSchedule` plus node labels for routing. Also recommend canary 2 H100 + 4 A10G first.

alex: Quick quota snapshot: filed an initial quota probe: Q-4821. Project currently has ~8 H100 and ~24 A10G remaining in europe-north1. If we want 6 H100 + 12 A10G steady plus buffer we likely need H100 quota bump to 14 and A10G to 30. @quota-team FYI.

ops-bot: provisioner-bot: autoscaler config check — suggested max 30 is fine, but validation flagged missing `scale-down-unneeded-time` and `max-node-provision-time`. Recommend explicit autoscaler flags to avoid thrash.

jing: Network note — europe-north1 Cloud NAT currently at ~70% of NAT connections during peak. Spinning up ~18 GPU nodes will add ~100-150 concurrent egress flows (image pulls + telemetry). Options: enable NAT auto-scaling or assign ephemeral external IPs to GPU nodes to reduce NAT pressure. Also consider enabling nodeLocalDNS and caching container registries in-region to cut egress.

chris: Cost reminder — rough hourly: H100 ~ $X/hr, A10G ~ $Y/hr (region-adjusted). If we run 6 H100 + 12 A10G at 50% average utilization monthly that's a non-trivial spend. If expected steady for H100 is >4 pods we should discuss reserved commitment for H100 to get discounts. Also consider preemptible mix for A10G to lower unit cost.

maria: Autoscaler policy suggestions: use conservative `scale-down-unneeded-time=15m`, `scale-down-unready-time=10m`, and `max-node-provision-time=15m` to avoid oscillation. Use `--balance-similar-node-groups=true` (GKE flag) so CA prefers AZ spread. Label scheme: `pool=eu-realtime|eu-embeds`, `gpu=h100|a10g`, `capacityType=on-demand|preemptible`. Tolerations/taints for placement.

noah: For canary I'm planning: 2 H100 (on-demand) + 4 A10G (2 on-demand, 2 preemptible). Expected pod counts for canary: realtime 4 pods (1 GPU each) and embeds 8 pods (0.25 GPU equivalent via our scheduler). Will file the quota request now and attach workload profiles.

alex: Quota request created: https://internal/quotas/Q-4821 — assigned to @quota-team, ticket Q-4821. ETA 48-72h for increases; put "europe-north1 — H100/A10G" in the subject.

jing: If quota approved, I'll pre-create node pools with this example (will adjust machine type and disk sizes based on infra prefs):

```
gcloud container node-pools create eu-h100-realtime \
  --cluster=redwood-eu \
  --region=europe-north1 \
  --machine-type=n1-standard-64 \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-h100,count=1 \
  --num-nodes=2 \
  --node-taints=gpu=h100:NoSchedule \
  --node-labels=pool=eu-realtime,gpu=h100,capacityType=on-demand
```
And autoscaler snippet: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cluster-autoscaler-config
data:
  maxNodesTotal: "30"
  maxNodesPerNodeGroup: "30"
  scaleDownUnneededTime: "15m"
```

ops-bot: infra-job-queue: nodepool-canary-create queued (job id: PJ-1034).

noah: Perfect — I'll attach workload traces & pod resource requests to Q-4821 and mark for canary first. Thanks all :thumbsup:

chris: One more — add monitoring alert for pod pending -> GPU insufficiency and a cost alert for sustained > 8 GPUs running for 6+ hours.

maria: Noted. I'll add the alerts and a rollout playbook (canary -> +2 nodes -> monitor 2h -> scale).

noah: Great. Waiting on quota, will update thread when Q-4821 advances. Thanks! :rocket:
